leadText:
Mr. Cheeves (Japanese: 管理人 Estate Manager) is a character of the day who appeared in Two Degrees of Separation!, as James's butler. He is the first character of the day to appear in .

Cheeves is part of the staff at James's second summer home in Sinnoh. Upon arriving after having a with , , and , and finding his , James summoned Cheeves with a food order for himself, Jessie, and . 

Once on the scene, however, Mr. Cheeves innocuously revealed that he had contacted James's parents about his arrival. As a result, they and Jessebelle would be arriving the next day, having expressed their eagerness to reunite with him. Consequently, it ruined 's plans of making the summer home their base of operations in Sinnoh.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
As is the case with James's other butlers, Hopkins and , Mr. Cheeves was unnamed in the Japanese version but was given a name in the dub.
Mr. Cheeves' name is likely a corruption of "Jeeves", the name of the valet from British author P.G. Wodehouse's series of novels and short stories; the name would become a generic one used to refer to valets and butlers.
